analysis.title: GS TMT TODAY 11.10.26
key_insights: Futures mixed early (Nasdaq -40bps, S&P flat), WTI down 2%, rates stable overnight. Macro focus is Fed speak ahead of October CPI and crude weakness.
Waller said he supports a 25bps hike in December regardless of today's CPI and would back 50bps if October core CPI prints above 0.3% m/m. Today's core CPI estimate is +0.3% m/m.

Crude weakness follows Axios reporting that Trump plans to hold off on further military strikes in Iran, and Al Arabiya reporting the US agreed to limited uranium enrichment in Iran under its new proposal.
NVDA fell 75bps premarket after underperforming the SOX Index by 11% yesterday, its biggest one-day underperformance of the last decade, amid continued fall-out from the 'Jensen scandal'.
Early price action shows rotation into Megas/Hyperscalers (GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN, META, AAPL all +50bps) and consolidation across Semis (-1 to -2%).

The Information reports the White House is considering new export controls on advanced Nvidia AI chips to China, via NDAA provisions. Commerce staff are also pushing rules on lithography tooling and on remote access to advanced AI chips by Chinese firms.
TSMC October revenue was NT$586.89 billion ($17.88 billion), up 59.7% y/y and 14.7% m/m. TSM was flat on the news.
TTWO rose about 3-3.5% premarket. FY27 bookings outlook was reiterated, GTA VI pre-orders are tracking well above initial expectations, and FY27 operating expense guidance was lowered (+5% y/y).

TTWO negatives: FQ2'27 bookings were below GSe/Street estimates on weaker NBA 2K27, and recurrent consumer spend fell 9% y/y versus management's -5% expectation. Management held FY27 guidance until it sees post-launch GTA VI data.
SE fell 6% on an EPS miss.

GS stays Sell on Entegris (ENTG) after its Capital Markets Day despite being incrementally constructive on its long-term financial framework. GS prefers Qnity (Buy) for stronger revenue growth and a more established position in advanced packaging and thermal management.

Skydance (SKYD, Not Rated) 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $1.0bn beat FactSet consensus of $913mn but missed GS's $1,166mn estimate. Warner Bros Film Studio underperformance creates a $200mn Studios EBITDA headwind in 4Q26.

SKYD reiterated a target of at least $6bn of cost synergies net of reinvestment within three years (30% in year one, 70% through year two). Costs to achieve are $4bn, with about $1.5-1.7bn in 2027. Breakeven FCF is expected in 2027.
GS views Anjali Sud's appointment as SiriusXM CEO (effective Jan 1, 2027) as positive. It supports the Buy thesis around the exclusive US audio advertising partnership with YouTube.
Asia rose overnight on tech: Nikkei +2.9%, KOSPI +4.39%. STOXX 600 is on track for its first record close since August, led by financials (+1.7%) and AI hardware, with Infineon +6.8% post-earnings.
Two tankers reportedly caught fire in Hormuz, one allegedly hit by a naval mine and the other under US military protection.

market_movers.rationale: GS remains Sell on relative growth rates and margins at similar or higher valuation than peers. It could turn more constructive if growth improves further.
GS prefers Qnity to Entegris on a stronger revenue growth profile and a more established position in advanced packaging and thermal management.
New CEO Anjali Sud is seen as a positive fit for the digital and advertising opportunity, including the exclusive YouTube US audio ad partnership.
3Q26 adjusted EBITDA beat consensus but missed GS's estimate. Synergy target reiterated, with a $200mn 4Q26 Studios EBITDA headwind.
The stock is under pressure from the Jensen scandal fall-out, and potential new China export controls via the NDAA are being considered.
GTA VI pre-orders are tracking above expectations and FY27 opex guidance was lowered, though FQ2 bookings and RCS missed.

sector_views.rationale: Early rotation from Semis (-1 to -2%) into Megas/Hyperscalers (+50bps), with no directional sector call stated.

earnings_insights: TTWO FQ2'27 (reported): bookings came in below GSe/Street estimates on NBA 2K27. RCS fell 9% y/y versus management's -5% expectation. FY27 bookings outlook reiterated. FY27 operating expense growth guided to +5% y/y, lowered.

SKYD 3Q26 (reported): adjusted EBITDA excluding SBC was $1.0bn versus FactSet consensus est $913mn and GS est $1,166mn. Paramount Skydance standalone is on track for the high end of its prior 2026 EBITDA outlook of $3.9bn.
SE: EPS miss reported, stock -6% premarket. No figures given.
Infineon reported earnings, stock +6.8% post-earnings in Europe.
TSMC October revenue (reported): NT$586.89bn, +59.7% y/y, +14.7% m/m.

Earnings today. Pre-market: BTDR, HSAI, Infineon, NOVT, QBTS, SE, SoftBank, WIX. Post-market: BV, CRWV, FLY, RGTI, SONO, STUB. Thursday 11/12 pre-market: LGN, NBIS. Post-market: AMAT, CBRS, CSCO, DLO, GEMI, LFTO, NMAX, NU, STNE.
